HPQ.thesis_one_line: Big PC and printer maker, cheap and cash-rich, but printing profits are shrinking and this year's raised outlook leans on one-off tariff refunds.
kill_criteria: Initial FY27 non-GAAP EPS guidance midpoint below $2.90 (ex tariff refunds), expected with the Q4 FY26 release in late Nov 2026.
Printing segment operating margin below 16.0% in any quarter (Q3 FY26 18.1%; segment table in the earnings release / 10-Q segment note).
Personal Systems operating margin below 4.0% for two consecutive quarters (Q3 FY26 4.6%).
Consolidated total debt above $10.0B or gross cash below $3.0B at any quarter end (10-Q liquidity table; currently $9,160M and $4.2B).
FY26 free cash flow reported below $2.8B (the original low end; guide is $3.0-3.2B).
key_adverse_facts: FY26 non-GAAP EPS guide raised to $3.19-$3.29 but includes $0.19 of tariff refunds; ex-refund $3.00-$3.10 is inside the May range of $2.90-$3.10
Q3 FY26 PC units down 16% while PC revenue up 18% on price increases; memory and storage costs rising
8-K 21 Sep 2026: planning assumption of industry PC units down roughly mid-single-digits in calendar 2027; no FY27 guidance
Interim CEO since 3 Feb 2026 after Enrique Lores left; no permanent CEO
Implied Q4 FY26 FCF of roughly $0.4-0.6B versus $1.5B a year earlier; FCF helped by payables at 151 days
India customs claim about $370M plus penalties still open
data_conflicts: Quick triage said growth low-single-digit; filings show 12.5% Q3 revenue growth driven by pricing, not volume
Triage card cited trained knowledge for print decline; replaced with Q3 FY26 segment data (Printing revenue -2%, supplies -3%)
HPQ.next_earnings_date_basis: estimated from 25 Nov 2025 prior-year release; not confirmed by company
HPQ.confidence_in_thesis: med: verdict is well supported by filings; valuation view depends on normalized FCF of $2.7B (my estimate)

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: [DV21 2026-10-08] No V1 row exists. Restated reverse DCF: Ke 9.9% (5.17% + Blume beta 1.14 x 4.14%), FCF less SBC ~$2.2B, 0% terminal: implied +3.4%/yr (+0.9% at 3% terminal) vs base -1.5%: above. Original: 9.5% Ke on $2.7B FCF implied -0.1%.

HPQ.scenario_basis: Start non-GAAP EPS $3.05 ex-refund at $31.30; base flat EPS, 10.3x exit, $1.20 dividend a year; bear EPS $2.40 at 8x; bull EPS $3.70 at 11x.

ECHO.thesis_one_line: Sold its wireless spectrum for about $40B; now holds about $14B cash plus a fixed-price stake of 262 million SpaceX shares due in late 2027, while two subsidiaries are in bankruptcy.
kill_criteria: Cash taxes disclosed for the AT&T plus SpaceX transactions above $6B in total (10-Q/10-K tax note, consolidated).
SpaceX acquisition closing not completed by 31 Mar 2028, or the $11B equity amount cut by amendment (8-K under Item 1.01/8.01).
Bankruptcy court orders or a Special Committee finding that shifts more than $1B of HSSC or DBS claims to the EchoStar parent (docket / 8-K).
Consolidated unrestricted cash plus marketable securities below $12B on the 31 Dec 2026 balance sheet (10-K consolidated balance sheet).
Wireless segment operating loss above $1.0B on an annualised basis after the hybrid transition (10-Q segment table).
key_adverse_facts: Hughes Satellite Systems and 11 subsidiaries filed Chapter 11 on 2 Aug 2026; $1.38B notes due 1 Aug 2026 accelerated/unpaid
DISH DBS and DISH Wireless in prepackaged Chapter 11 since 30 Jun 2026; retained equity valued at $0; net liabilities $11.4B deconsolidated
Cash taxes on AT&T and SpaceX gains not quantified in the 10-Q; deferred tax liability $3.4B
SpaceX closing targeted 30 Nov 2027; SpaceX shares priced at fixed $42.40, value per share is private and not in filings
Q2 2026 net income of $8.46B is a non-cash $9.73B deconsolidation gain; revenue down 4% y/y
Special Committee reviewing related-party transactions between Hughes and EchoStar
data_conflicts: Triage and b1 data card show legacy net debt/EBITDA 8.6x and negative margins; pre-closing and pre-deconsolidation, so superseded by the 30 Jun 2026 10-Q and 28 Jul 2026 8-K
b1 market cap $31.7B uses diluted shares of about 351.6M times price; basic shares are 290.5M
Web analyst commentary values the SpaceX stake at $39-55B; not a primary source and not used in base case
ECHO.next_earnings_date_basis: estimated from 6 Nov 2025 prior-year 10-Q; not confirmed by company
ECHO.confidence_in_thesis: low: equity value depends on undisclosed taxes, unobservable SpaceX price and unresolved subsidiary bankruptcies

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse sum-of-parts: market cap implies SpaceX at about $87 a share versus my base $100 and contract $42.40; margin of error (taxes, burn) is about +/- $8 a share so kept at WATCH.

ECHO.scenario_basis: Equity = $8.6B (post-tax cash and SpaceX-leg adjustments, my estimates) + 261.8M SpaceX shares x $42.40/$100/$149, over 348.6M diluted shares; start $90.11; no dividend.

GLW.thesis_one_line: Makes the optical fibre and glass behind AI data centres; sales and profit are growing fast and beating its own forecasts, but the share price already assumes years of that.
kill_criteria: Core sales guidance midpoint for any coming quarter below $4.9B (Q3 26 guide $4.9-5.0B) or core EPS growth below 20% y/y for two consecutive quarters (Q2 26: +30%).
Optical Communications segment sales growth below 20% y/y in any quarter (Q2 26: +32%; segment table in the earnings release).
Total debt above $9.5B or cumulative ATM/warrant share issuance above 30M shares (10-Q debt table; currently $8.4B).
TTM adjusted FCF excluding customer deposits below $1.5B at the Q4 26 report.
key_adverse_facts: Q2 2026 adjusted free cash flow of $1.42B includes a $1.0B upfront customer deposit; H1 ex-deposit about $0.6B
Price $156.74 is about 42x my NTM core EPS and 1.4-2.1% FCF yield
Share-based comp $250M in H1 26 versus $117M; employee withholding payments $279M versus $70M
Opened $2.0B at-the-market equity programme 11 Sep 2026 and sold a $180-strike warrant for 15M shares plus 3M pre-funded warrant for $500M to a customer
Heavy insider selling: CEO 100,000 shares at $186.46 on 9 Jun 2026; seven insiders sold since May
Solar wafer plant had an extended shutdown in Q2; profitability only expected to improve from Q3
data_conflicts: Triage said stock up 83% in a year and 0.5% FCF yield; filings-based ex-deposit TTM FCF yield is 1.4%; stock has since fallen from about $207 (May) to $157
b1 fcfp is missing; computed from release adjusted FCF instead
GLW.next_earnings_date_basis: estimated from 28 Oct 2025 and 28 Jul 2026 cadence; not confirmed by company
GLW.confidence_in_thesis: med-high on business quality (guidance beaten four quarters in a row); med on valuation because the bull case depends on internal Springboard targets

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 9% WACC and 3.5% terminal growth implies 18.9% 10-year FCF CAGR versus my base 14% and bull 20%.

GLW.scenario_basis: Start NTM core EPS $3.77 (my estimate) at $156.74; Sep 2029 NTM core EPS $4.3/$6.0/$7.6 at 18x/28x/32x; dividends about $1.15 a year.
